mapper.select: select id, user_id, name, cover_url, description, created_time, category from playlist where id = #{id}
select m.id, m.title, m.artist, m.cover_url, m.duration_sec from playlist_music pm join music m on pm.music_id = m.id where pm.playlist_id = #{playlistId} order by pm.sort_order asc
mapper.insert: insert into playlist ( user_id, name, cover_url, description, created_time, category ) values ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{coverUrl}, #{description}, #{createdTime}, #{category} )
insert into playlist_music (playlist_id, music_id, sort_order) values (#{playlistId}, #{musicId}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: select id, name, cover_url, description from playlist where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc
